text:
Nina (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands about hybrid/office ops 1 travel, desk hoteling, offsites, reimbursements. Drop short Qs here and we'll answer.
Harper: If we do a 3-day offsite in Dublin, do per-diems change vs SF?
Nina (People Ops): Yes 1 per-diem varies by country. Ops will apply the Ireland rate automatically if we book, otherwise attach the country code in Concur and use PER_DIEM.
Ethan: Visa fees: company pays for business visa application fees if it's a company-requested stay?
Nina (People Ops): Correct. For company-requested travel >30 days we cover visa fees; code as VISA_SUPPORT and include receipts. Start the request early so ops can loop in immigration vendor.
Renee: How long does Concur reimbursement usually take? I submitted travel last week.
Nina (People Ops): Typical turnaround is 7-10 business days after manager approval. If it's longer, DM me and I'll escalate. Ops audits monthly.
Sofia: Is there a policy for charging EV charging at hubs? My car is electric and I'm curious if we reimburse charging while on a company visit.
nina (typo): (oops) Nina (People Ops): Yes, EV charging while on company travel is reimbursable under LOCAL_PARKING if you include a brief note with the charge. Keep receipts.
Harper: Any limit for shipping equipment to another country for a temp offsite?
Nina (People Ops): Shipments of company equipment are covered. For cross-border shipments we may need customs paperwork; ops will coordinate. Code EQUIPMENT_SHIP and include tracking + customs docs.
Ethan: For managers approving same-day travel, is there a cap?
Nina (People Ops): Managers can approve up to $1,000/person for last-minute travel. Above that, ops approval required.
Renee: Childcare reimbursement during mandatory offsites 1 is there a cap?
Nina (People Ops): We reimburse reasonable childcare costs directly related to company travel. No hard cap but require manager pre-approval and receipts. Code TRAVEL_CHILDCARE.
Sofia: Is there a dedicated slack channel to request emergency desk access when the portal is down?
Nina (People Ops): Yes 1 ping @people-ops or post in #people-ops with "desk-emergency" and ops-bot will create a ticket.
ops-bot: ticket: Created desk-emergency ticket #4532 for Sofia.
Harper: Are we piloting any regional remote stipends (APAC/EU)?
Nina (People Ops): We have an APAC hub stipend pilot for select roles. If you think you qualify, DM me the location & role.
Ethan: Do we cover insurance for international offsites? Like travel insurance if the trip is company-requested?
Nina (People Ops): We provide travel insurance for company-directed international travel. Ops will book if travel is organized by the company; otherwise you can expense a personal policy under HEALTH_TRAVEL with approval.
Renee: Can teams rent vans/carpools for offsites and expense gas?
Nina (People Ops): Yes 1 rental vehicles and fuel for company offsites are reimbursable. Use GROUP_TRANSPORT and include driver names. For employee personal carpool mileage, use LOCAL_MILEAGE rates in Concur.
Sofia: Quick ask: if I'm on a dedicated seat plan but need to reserve an alternate hub for a week, how to do that?
Nina (People Ops): Email people-ops with dates & preferred hub. We'll provision a temporary seat if capacity allows and update your seating record.
Harper: Will you post a short one-pager with codes & timelines?
Nina (People Ops): Yes 1 will post a one-pager + a 4-min Loom walkthrough of Concur codes, desk portal tips, and the overflow plan. Expect it by EOD.
Ethan: thanks, super helpful.
Renee: Appreciate it!
ops-bot: calendar: Posted event "All-Hands Ops: Followups (Hybrid & Travel)" with Nina's notes.
